note: Music cue sheet of the two clips. Only CC0 tracks are allowed. Nothing is downloaded by the tooling; the owner approves a track after reading the licence line on its page (see ../music.md). The mixer takes one music file per film, so the relative levels below are guidance for the owner and for a later per-chapter mix; a chapter cut starts the track from its beginning.
